responsive.reason: Static file reviewed without a browser; viewport behavior could not be rendered

findings.title: Primary CTA removes its focus outline with no replacement

verification.note: Line 27 contains the rule. Searched the whole file for :focus-visible, box-shadow and border changes on .cta-btn; none exist, so keyboard focus is invisible.

findings.title: White CTA label on #e94560 fails AA contrast

measurement.method: WCAG 2.x relative luminance, #ffffff on #e94560, 16px regular (normal text)

findings.recommendation: Darken the button background until white text reaches 4.5:1, or set the label to 18.66px bold so the 3:1 large-text threshold applies.

verification.note: Recomputed from the declared colors: 3.83:1. Font-size is 16px at normal weight, so the 4.5:1 threshold applies.

findings.title: Feature icons have no alt attribute
findings.recommendation: The icons are decorative next to their headings: add alt="" to all three.

verification.note: Lines 82, 87 and 92: three elements, none with alt, aria-label, aria-hidden or role=presentation.

findings.title: Feature body copy #777 on white is just under AA
findings.recommendation: Darken secondary body text one step, e.g. to #6b6b6b, and re-check it reaches 4.5:1.

verification.note: The card has no background of its own and inherits white from body. Recomputed 4.48:1, below 4.5:1.

findings.title: Hero subtitle #888 on #1a1a2e fails AA contrast

measurement.method: Estimate taken from the source comment on line 17

verification.note: Recomputed #888888 on #1a1a2e: 4.81:1, which passes the 4.5:1 threshold for 18px regular text. The 3.1:1 figure came from a source comment, not a measurement.

findings.title: Three feature cards compete at equal weight
findings.recommendation: Promote the most important feature with a larger card or an accent border.

verification.note: The cards share identical styles, but whether equal weight is a problem depends on product priorities; this needs a human design call.
